Obviously you need the Pruna H3 Image models to run it. Otherwise is almost purely a reference node swap out of the Q21 Version 2.1 Basic, with some minor tweaks:

First an additional section was put in for behind views. I actually have a Q21 version with that feature that I may upload later. Second, I added in a background removal nodes since (at least as far as I know) pH3 won't do alpha channels. I've also taken away the ability to toggle alpha channel on or off in the autotrim subgraph. It's still there if you want to bypass the background remover and would rather trust H3 to give you a white background. In my experience it often will put a shadow under the character, which will make it so the autotrim does not work properly (it works by measuring the differences between pixels).

A custom ComfyUI workflow for MiniMax P-H3-Image, designed to make high-quality image generation and reference-based image editing simple and accessible.

Features

  • Reference Editing: Use up to two reference images to guide image generation and editing.

  • One-Click Mode Switching: Switch between Text-to-Image and Reference Editing using a simple toggle.

  • Adjustable Resolution: Experiment with image resolution settings.

  • Optimized Workflow Layout: Organized nodes for convenient everyday use.</

MiniMax H3 Multiangle Workflow for ComfyUI

Change the camera viewpoint of a reference image with MiniMax H3. Start with a single image and explore a three-quarter view, a high or low angle, or a tighter crop. The interactive 3D camera panel lets you adjust the horizontal angle, vertical angle, and framing before generating the edit.

Use Match Background View to control how MiniMax H3 handles the scene. Turn it on to request the original surroundings from the new viewpoint. Turn it off to place the subject against a plain background. You can also use Additional Prompt to ask the model to preserve details such as the outfit, hairstyle, or lighting.
